France-Morocco World Cup Quarter-Final: Team News and Coach Comments

Ahead of the FIFA World Cup quarter-final match between France and Morocco, Morocco's player Ismael Saibari has been ruled out due to a hamstring injury. French coach Didier Deschamps emphasized the need for his team to be "efficient" in the upcoming game. Meanwhile, the appointment of Argentine referee Facundo Tello for the match has already generated discussion.
